items.title: Is Moderna's Cancer Vaccine a Game Changer for the Stock?
items.summary: The healthcare stock has hit multi-year highs this year amid positive results from its personalized cancer vaccine.

items.title: Flagship Pioneering expands to UK with £100m AI-native lab
items.summary: The Moderna creator’s investment in the UK marks another sign of turning tides for the UK life sciences sector, following prior big pharma funding pullouts.

items.title: Moderna Is Up Over 600% This Year. Here’s What Jim Cramer Learned in His Exclusive
items.summary: One melanoma headline turned a $63 stock into a market darling, and Moderna's CEO just told Jim Cramer when patients could get the shot. Does the price already bake in the cancer breakthrough, or is the next catalyst still ahead?

items.title: Flagship's Afeyan Sees UK Bet Creating Next Moderna
items.summary: Flagship Pioneering founder and CEO Noubar Afeyan says the biotech venture firm hopes its new UK investment can grow to as much as £600 million "relatively soon," as it establishes its first full-scale company-creation operation outside the US. Speaking on Bloomberg's "The Pulse With Francine Lacqua", the Moderna co-founder explains why Flagship chose the UK, how AI could accelerate drug discovery and the creation of new biotech companies, and why governments and industry need agreed safeguards for increasingly autonomous AI agents.

items.title: Proshares Trust (TQQQ) Buys $72.9 Million More Moderna on Nov. 12
items.summary: The 3x leveraged Nasdaq-100 fund added a $72.9 million Moderna stake while trimming 100 positions and net selling $101.1 million.

items.title: What Invesco S&P 500 Equal Weight ETF (RSP) Bought: Moderna Leads on Nov. 12
items.summary: The fund added $319.5 million in gross purchases, lifting all 503 positions and making no sales.

items.title: Moderna (MRNA) Sees $109.7 Million in Net ETF Buying on Nov. 12
items.summary: ETFs bought $109.7 million of Moderna stock on Thursday, Nov. 12.

items.title: Moderna Sinks 12% in a Week. Bancel Wants an FDA Filing “Before the End of the Year”
items.summary: Key TakeawaysModerna fell 12% in the week to Nov. 13 after guiding to about $4 billion or more of cash costs a year through 2030, mostly for cancer drugs.
